identity.source: #141 AC1–2 (closed representation, 只能构造有效 target); #138 Revocation-target decision
identity.defect: The constructors accepted unrestricted strings: Current("") constructed a current target without a session identity and Others with an empty user or empty exception silently widened the disposition to all, contradicting the package's own documented closed-validity claim that 'a current without a session identity' is unexpressable.

findings.dispositionReason: Verified against the pre-repair code and the package's own RevocationTarget doc comment, which promised that a current without a session identity cannot be expressed while Current("") expressed exactly that. AC1 requires 只能构造有效 target. Repair: all three constructors now validate and return (RevocationTarget, error), refusing absent identities; Logout constructs before the transaction and maps refusal to the command error surface; a pure unit test (TestRevocationTargetConstructorsRefuseAbsentIdentities) pins refusal and the three valid forms. The finding's cross-user Others case is not a field-combination violation (both ids always derive from one guard-validated session row at every call site) and is documented as out of the constructible-invariant scope.
evidence: pre-repair session.go RevocationTarget doc: 'can never express an invalid combination such as an all with an exception or a current without a session identity' — while Current("") compiled and constructed
spec #141 AC1: 只能构造有效 target，不存在 enum 与 optional field 的非法组合
post-repair: Current/Others/All return errors on empty required identities; auth.Logout validates before runner.Run; session_test.go refuses all four absent-identity forms
